response.sql: WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS overall_average FROM per_media_type) SELECT p.media_type_name, p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond, p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond - o.overall_average AS amount_above_overall_average FROM per_media_type AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond > o.overall_average

assumptions.assumption: A track with zero milliseconds has an undefined bytes-per-millisecond value, so AVG excludes it.
